_comment: Per-command help: `offload help CMD` and `offload CMD --help` print these in both engines.
read:
offload read -q QUESTION PATH... [-m MODEL] [--no-verify] [--no-cache] [--allow-secrets]

A cheap worker answers a question about files you name (a directory, or file:START-END for a range).
The answer cites path:Lx-Ly with a quote, and every quote is checked against the file.

Examples:
  offload read -q "what does applyLateFee do and where is the rate set?" src/ledger.ts
  offload read -q "which endpoints lack auth?" src/api/
  offload read -q "why does this test fail?" tests/cart.test.ts:1-120 src/cart.ts

Then Read only the cited lines before you edit. ⚠unverified means the quote was not found there.
The same question about unchanged files within an hour is answered from the earlier checked answer ("cached").
explore:
offload explore QUESTION [-m MODEL]

A read-only worker searches the repository itself (glob, grep, read) and answers with checked citations.
For "where/how is X done?" across many files.

Examples:
  offload explore "where are refunds computed, and which tests cover them?"
  offload explore "how does the app load its config at startup?"
run:
offload run [-q FOCUS] -- CMD...      (or: offload run -c 'CMD with | pipes')

Runs a noisy command and prints a digest: verbatim error lines, the tail, an optional summary, the full-log
path. Keeps the command's exit code, so it works where failing output can't be replaced by a hook.

Examples:
  offload run -- npm test
  offload run -q "why does the build fail?" -- cargo build
  offload run -c 'make 2>&1 | tee build.log'
summarize:
offload summarize [-q FOCUS] [FILE] [--no-model]      (stdin when no FILE)

Digests a long log or output you already have.

Examples:
  offload summarize ci.log
  kubectl logs pod/api | offload summarize -q "any errors after the restart?"
write:
offload write --spec SPEC --ref EXAMPLE_FILE [--context FILE]... [--out NEW_FILE] [--check CMD]

Writes boilerplate that follows an existing file's patterns (tests, configs, stubs). --check runs a command on
the result (e.g. the tests) and returns 1 when it fails. Review what it writes.

Example:
  offload write --spec "tests for quote() bulk tiers" --ref tests/test_cart.py --context src/pricing.py \
    --out tests/test_pricing.py --check "pytest -q tests/test_pricing.py"
ask:
offload ask [--stdin|-f FILE] QUESTION

A plain question to the worker, optionally about piped text or a file (no citations).

Example:
  git log -20 --stat | offload ask --stdin "which areas changed most this week?"
task:
offload task NAME [-q QUESTION] [--stdin] [PATH...]

Runs one of your own tasks (tasks.NAME in the config): your instructions plus offload's citation rules.
`offload tasks` lists them; `offload tasks templates` shows ready-made ones and
`offload tasks add NAME --from TEMPLATE` copies one into your config.

Examples:
  offload task review-sql src/db/
  git diff | offload task review-sql --stdin
model:
offload model [TASK] [REF...] [--reset] [--project]

Shows which model does each kind of work, or changes it. A REF is BACKEND:MODEL (claude:haiku,
groq:llama-3.3-70b), provider/model for OpenCode, @host (your agent's own model) or @default.

Examples:
  offload model                         # show
  offload model claude:haiku            # every kind of work
  offload model read openrouter:qwen/qwen3-coder
  offload model fallback @host-api @default
  offload model --reset
explain:
offload explain [N]

What the hooks did lately, newest first: blocked reads, digests, search views, repeats — each with the rule,
its current value and the command to change it or turn it off.
stats:
offload stats [--days N] [--json|--csv]

Delegations and the tokens kept out of your agent's context (estimates: bytes ÷ 4), worker tokens (as
reported), blocked reads (extra turns), citations, per-model latency. --csv exports every record.
config:
offload config show|path|init|get|set KEY VALUE|validate|trust [--project]

show merges defaults, your config and the repo's; validate reports mistyped keys; trust lets this repo's
.harness-offload.json set binaries, endpoints and privacy options.

Examples:
  offload config set hooks.read_threshold_lines 1200
  offload config set hooks.read_guard suggest --project
  offload config validate
doctor:
offload doctor [--ping] [--reset] [--json]

Checks the runtime, config, models and hooks. --ping makes one live call per model (it costs a little),
--reset clears cooldowns, --json prints the result for scripts.
